subject.title: [Feature]: Allow hiding progress activity receipt while keeping commentary

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported per-channel control for the final progress activity receipt, independent of transient commentary and tool-progress visibility?
rationale: The request needs a new public configuration surface, and maintainers must choose its permanent scope and semantics across shared progress-mode channels before implementation.

options.title: Adopt a narrow receipt toggle
options.body: Add a default-on `streaming.progress` visibility control for the final receipt, initially covering channels that append it after progress-mode completion.

options.title: Keep receipts fixed
options.body: Retain the current receipt as inseparable progress-mode provenance and document that commentary requires accepting it.

options.title: Design a broader presentation policy
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers define a single shared completion-presentation policy rather than adding another boolean.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow receipt toggle
recommendation.body: Add a default-on `streaming.progress` visibility control for the final receipt, initially covering channels that append it after progress-mode completion.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the related narrated-status and final-receipt design.
